name: _scroll-lock.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  modal/_scroll-lock.scss — scroll-lock rules — html.modal-open overflow locks, the dialog.modal-above fullscreen layer, and the .modal-open page state (nav hidden, modal titlebar shown).
//  Imported by modal.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Scroll-lock while any modal is open (JS adds .modal-open to <html>/<body>).
html.modal-open,
html.modal-open body,
html:has(.modal-open),
html:has(.modal-open) body,
html:has(dialog[open].modal-above),
html:has(dialog[open].modal-above) body {
  overflow: hidden;
}

// The expand dialog: fixed fullscreen layer above everything (media expand view).
dialog.modal-above,
.modal-above {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 100vw;
  max-width: 100vw;
  height: 100vh;
  height: 100dvh;
  max-height: 100dvh;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  z-index: 9999;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
  color: inherit;

  &::backdrop {
    background: var(--bg-dark);
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
  }
}

// Page state when a modal is open.
.modal-open {
  // Lock page scroll behind the modal
  body {
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .modal-below {
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    position: fixed;
  }

  // Hide regular nav links in modal context
  .nav .nav-link {
    display: none;
  }

  // Show modal title bar instead
  .modal-titlebar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }
}
